start_here: Say to your AI: "Derive the current tools of my connected source tool:fixture:any without opening my account records", with {"need": "tool:fixture:any", "wait": false}. It runs tool:derive-current-api-description-rows and answers that source's tools as rows.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it derives one source's tools as rows and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Find the id of the source you want with tool:read-my-api-descriptions.

2. Say "Derive the current tools of that source". The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:derive-current-api-description-rows and {"need": <the id>, "wait": false}.
3. Read the answer's reads: the tool rows the source offers now, ready to compare with the rows you keep.
